study/hypothesis: Liquids with an O–H group have a higher implied ΔS_vap (ds_implied) than liquids without a donor, so their vapour pressure lies below the boiling-point prediction.
study/name: Do hydrogen-bond donors evaporate less than Trouton predicts?
study/question: Among pure liquids on Wikidata, is the entropy of vaporisation implied by a room-temperature vapour pressure higher for liquids with an O–H donor than for liquids with no hydrogen-bond donor?
